title: Complete Intro to Flamenco Dance Class

method.teacher_system: The teacher introduces the cultural context of the dance. She then breaks down the hand clapping rhythm (palmas) and the arm/hand movements separately. Finally, she combines these elements into a follow-along practice routine.
method.signature: The teacher explains the concept of 'compas' as both a musical measure and a state of being in rhythm, using the analogy of a favorite song to help learners recognize the rhythm.

practices.what: The teacher demonstrates the four-count rhythm of tangos by clapping and counting aloud.
The teacher breaks down the hand-clapping technique (palmas) with a syncopated rhythm.
The teacher leads the learner through multiple repetitions of the palmas pattern.
The teacher practices the palmas pattern along with guitar music.
The teacher introduces arm and upper body positions, emphasizing rounded arms and engaged back muscles.
The teacher breaks down the hand movements, starting from the pinky finger and moving through the wrist.
The teacher drills the hand movements in both directions.
The teacher leads the practice of arm and hand movements, starting very slowly and then speeding up.

adaptations.adjustment: The teacher suggests holding the forearm and making circles with the wrist to work towards better mobility.

adaptations.difficulty: Maintaining balance and posture while focusing on arms.
adaptations.adjustment: The teacher advises placing one foot in front of the other to support the lower back and engage the core.

beliefs.belief: Flamenco is a cultural art form involving singing, dancing, and guitar that connects people and expresses emotion.

feelings.response: The teacher explains how to engage the upper back to support the arms and avoid fatigue.

moments.says: The teacher welcomes the learner to the intro to flamenco workshop, introducing herself and her background.
The teacher explains what flamenco is before diving into the workshop details and rhythm practice.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling welcomed and equipped with a foundational understanding of flamenco rhythm and posture.

struggles.theme: Difficulty with coordination and feeling insecure
Feeling overwhelmed by the amount of information

meant.theme: Using flamenco for exercise and health

method.limits: The video does not show the teacher's feet during the entire lesson, which makes it difficult to see the footwork clearly.
